\section[(dialogue)]{The body, health and family — a first pass}

\label{lesson:FA-R44-first-pass-the-body-health-and-family}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for cheese and milk; a lion.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item the head, an ear, a nose, a mouth, a tooth
  \item hair, a finger, a shoulder; a comb, the neck, the face
  \item blood, a knee, the back, the belly, a lip
  \item the heart, an arm, a fever, a hospital, ill
  \item pain, medicine, thirsty, hungry, happy
  \item upset, a doctor, a grandfather, a grandmother, an uncle
  \item an aunt, a husband, a spouse, a child, a family
  \item a neighbour, a guest, a university student, a gentleman; Mr, a lady; Mrs
  \item to eat, to drink, to see, to hear, to sit
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
The head? (\textbf{\fa{سر}}, \emph{sar}.) An ear? (\textbf{\fa{گوش}}, \emph{gush}.) A nose? (\textbf{\fa{بینی}}, \emph{bini}.) A mouth? (\textbf{\fa{دهان}}, \emph{dahân}.) A tooth? (\textbf{\fa{دندان}}, \emph{dandân}.) Hair? (\textbf{\fa{مو}}, \emph{mu}.) A finger? (\textbf{\fa{انگشت}}, \emph{angosht}.) A shoulder; a comb? (\textbf{\fa{شانه}}, \emph{shâne}.) The neck? (\textbf{\fa{گردن}}, \emph{gardan}.) The face? (\textbf{\fa{صورت}}, \emph{surat}.) Blood? (\textbf{\fa{خون}}, \emph{khun}.) A knee? (\textbf{\fa{زانو}}, \emph{zânu}.) The back? (\textbf{\fa{پشت}}, \emph{posht}.) The belly? (\textbf{\fa{شکم}}, \emph{shekam}.) A lip? (\textbf{\fa{لب}}, \emph{lab}.) The heart? (\textbf{\fa{قلب}}, \emph{ghalb}.) An arm? (\textbf{\fa{بازو}}, \emph{bâzu}.) A fever? (\textbf{\fa{تب}}, \emph{tab}.) A hospital? (\textbf{\fa{بیمارستان}}, \emph{bimârestân}.) Ill? (\textbf{\fa{بیمار}}, \emph{bimâr}.) Pain? (\textbf{\fa{درد}}, \emph{dard}.) Medicine? (\textbf{\fa{دارو}}, \emph{dâru}.) Thirsty? (\textbf{\fa{تشنه}}, \emph{teshne}.) Hungry? (\textbf{\fa{گرسنه}}, \emph{gorosne}.) Happy? (\textbf{\fa{خوشحال}}, \emph{khoshhâl}.) Upset? (\textbf{\fa{ناراحت}}, \emph{nârâhat}.) A doctor? (\textbf{\fa{پزشک}}, \emph{pezeshk}.) A grandfather? (\textbf{\fa{پدربزرگ}}, \emph{pedarbozorg}.) A grandmother? (\textbf{\fa{مادربزرگ}}, \emph{mâdarbozorg}.) An uncle? (\textbf{\fa{دایی}}, \emph{dâyi}.) An aunt? (\textbf{\fa{خاله}}, \emph{khâle}.) A husband? (\textbf{\fa{شوهر}}, \emph{shohar}.) A spouse? (\textbf{\fa{همسر}}, \emph{hamsar}.) A child? (\textbf{\fa{بچه}}, \emph{bachche}.) A family? (\textbf{\fa{خانواده}}, \emph{khânevâde}.) A neighbour? (\textbf{\fa{همسایه}}, \emph{hamsâye}.) A guest? (\textbf{\fa{مهمان}}, \emph{mehmân}.) A university student? (\textbf{\fa{دانشجو}}, \emph{dâneshju}.) A gentleman; Mr? (\textbf{\fa{آقا}}, \emph{âghâ}.) A lady; Mrs? (\textbf{\fa{خانم}}, \emph{khânom}.) To eat? (\textbf{\fa{خوردن}}, \emph{khordan}.) To drink? (\textbf{\fa{نوشیدن}}, \emph{nushidan}.) To see? (\textbf{\fa{دیدن}}, \emph{didan}.) To hear? (\textbf{\fa{شنیدن}}, \emph{shenidan}.) To sit? (\textbf{\fa{نشستن}}, \emph{neshastan}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[(dialogue)]{Verbs — a second pass}

\label{lesson:FA-R44-second-pass-verbs}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for to sleep and to stand.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item to sleep, to stand, to run, to buy, to sell
  \item to give, to close, to cook, to wash, to laugh
  \item to dance, to want, to bring, to send, to count
  \item to cut, to look for; to wander, to wear, to come back, to take away; to win
  \item to become, to build, a fish, rice, meat
  \item fruit, an apple, a banana, a tomato, a carrot
  \item sugar, salt, butter, grapes, an orange
  \item a lemon, yoghurt, an onion, breakfast, lunch
  \item dinner, juice, a cake, cheese, milk; a lion
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
To sleep? (\textbf{\fa{خوابیدن}}, \emph{khâbidan}.) To stand? (\textbf{\fa{ایستادن}}, \emph{istâdan}.) To run? (\textbf{\fa{دویدن}}, \emph{davidan}.) To buy? (\textbf{\fa{خریدن}}, \emph{kharidan}.) To sell? (\textbf{\fa{فروختن}}, \emph{forukhtan}.) To give? (\textbf{\fa{دادن}}, \emph{dâdan}.) To close? (\textbf{\fa{بستن}}, \emph{bastan}.) To cook? (\textbf{\fa{پختن}}, \emph{pokhtan}.) To wash? (\textbf{\fa{شستن}}, \emph{shostan}.) To laugh? (\textbf{\fa{خندیدن}}, \emph{khandidan}.) To dance? (\textbf{\fa{رقصیدن}}, \emph{raghsidan}.) To want? (\textbf{\fa{خواستن}}, \emph{khâstan}.) To bring? (\textbf{\fa{آوردن}}, \emph{âvardan}.) To send? (\textbf{\fa{فرستادن}}, \emph{ferestâdan}.) To count? (\textbf{\fa{شمردن}}, \emph{shemordan}.) To cut? (\textbf{\fa{بریدن}}, \emph{boridan}.) To look for; to wander? (\textbf{\fa{گشتن}}, \emph{gashtan}.) To wear? (\textbf{\fa{پوشیدن}}, \emph{pushidan}.) To come back? (\textbf{\fa{برگشتن}}, \emph{bargashtan}.) To take away; to win? (\textbf{\fa{بردن}}, \emph{bordan}.) To become? (\textbf{\fa{شدن}}, \emph{shodan}.) To build? (\textbf{\fa{ساختن}}, \emph{sâkhtan}.) A fish? (\textbf{\fa{ماهی}}, \emph{mâhi}.) Rice? (\textbf{\fa{برنج}}, \emph{berenj}.) Meat? (\textbf{\fa{گوشت}}, \emph{gusht}.) Fruit? (\textbf{\fa{میوه}}, \emph{miveh}.) An apple? (\textbf{\fa{سیب}}, \emph{sib}.) A banana? (\textbf{\fa{موز}}, \emph{moz}.) A tomato? (\textbf{\fa{گوجه}}, \emph{gowje}.) A carrot? (\textbf{\fa{هویج}}, \emph{havij}.) Sugar? (\textbf{\fa{شکر}}, \emph{shekar}.) Salt? (\textbf{\fa{نمک}}, \emph{namak}.) Butter? (\textbf{\fa{کره}}, \emph{kare}.) Grapes? (\textbf{\fa{انگور}}, \emph{angur}.) An orange? (\textbf{\fa{پرتقال}}, \emph{porteghâl}.) A lemon? (\textbf{\fa{لیمو}}, \emph{limu}.) Yoghurt? (\textbf{\fa{ماست}}, \emph{mâst}.) An onion? (\textbf{\fa{پیاز}}, \emph{piyâz}.) Breakfast? (\textbf{\fa{صبحانه}}, \emph{sobhâne}.) Lunch? (\textbf{\fa{ناهار}}, \emph{nâhâr}.) Dinner? (\textbf{\fa{شام}}, \emph{shâm}.) Juice? (\textbf{\fa{آبمیوه}}, \emph{âbmive}.) A cake? (\textbf{\fa{کیک}}, \emph{keyk}.) Cheese? (\textbf{\fa{پنیر}}, \emph{panir}.) Milk; a lion? (\textbf{\fa{شیر}}, \emph{shir}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
